source: Stanford Large Movie Review Dataset (Maas et al., ACL 2011)
selection: Shuffle 50,000 mirror rows with Python Random(seed); deduplicate lowercase whitespace-normalized full reviews; take first 800 per label, first 600 train and next 200 validation.
splitNote: The mirror does not preserve official train/test membership. These are newly assigned course splits, not the official IMDb benchmark. Held-out rows are validation during model selection.
